svg.title: Ragged regions — 025 / What the room does not have — 27 June responders
svg.desc: Fog of war, Ragged regions: 025 / What the room does not have, 27 June responders. Schematic drawn claim terrain; P1 hatched; P2 dark; P3 dark; P4 dark; P5 dark. P1 outer foothold hatched. Observation islands: response lit, correction dark, configuration dark, weights dark, staging dark. P6 remains dark and unreachable. Dark means no available support, not false. Contours remain fixed across fixtures. Design sample, not adopted. Shaded relief with a soft, irregular fog edge; unexplored ground is opaque, ground that lost support stays dimly visible. Many pictograms lie draped on the ground beneath the fog, not text; a key names them outside the map.
svg.text: 025 / What the room does not have
ONE FORM OF EACH FAMILY SHOWN / ALL LIE UNDER THE FOG
THE ALERT DOES NOT ARRIVE AS THE WHOLE STORY.
024; 025.4 / staged plugin and persistent users documented; boundary inferred · OUR INFERENCE / SCHEMATIC RELIEF / FOG IS COMPUTED, NOT MEASURED
